data.one_liner: Save, append, and pick files using Android MediaStore
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to save files, append data, and pick files directly through Android's MediaStore and Scoped Storage system. It handles storage permissions automatically across different Android versions.
use_when: You need to save files into Android's MediaStore in compliance with Scoped Storage
You need to append data to existing files stored in the MediaStore
You need to pick single or multiple files from the device storage on Android
avoid_when: Your application targets iOS or platforms other than Android
You only need general local file system path management without MediaStore integration
strengths: Seamless integration with Android Scoped Storage and MediaStore
Automatic permission handling based on the Android SDK version
Supports multi-file picking and appending data to existing files
weaknesses: Requires manual addition of native permissions in AndroidManifest.xml
data.setup_notes: Add required Android permissions (READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, or MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) to AndroidManifest.xml depending on the target API levels.
